## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `bd8baf26940f540a2886bd4155ba5d923e6ad99f`
Local-runs: none
Scope: .claude/agents/os-dev.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/review-checklist.md + .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/execution-duties.md (L3, L177), .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/landing-operations.md (L8-13, L61, L73-75), .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/contract-review.md (L12), .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md (L280), .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/skills.md (L20, L29), AGENTS.md (L11-14, L236-237, L339-340, L531-533, L586, L1088), scripts/pm/clause2-line.mjs, scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs, scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs, scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs, scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs (the H52 reader), scripts/pm/check-settings-deny-roster.mjs (header), scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs (ceilings), scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs (register), .github/workflows/ci.yml (the dogfood job), .github/workflows/pr-automation.yml (the Check Changeset job), packages/qa/dogfood/package.json, packages/qa/dogfood/vitest.config.ts, .changeset/24583-7a3-sharing-null-readers.md, .changeset/24583-7b3-organizationless-counter-retired.md, .changeset/24765-team-sessions-related-list.md, .changeset/24813-adopt-orphans-readonly-package.md

Inputs: card #24890 body and both comments (the claim and the os-dev-report), PR #24917 body, file list (2 files, +7/−7) and net diff against main, and the check-runs on the head. The branch is one commit off merge-base a8b44d407; head repo = base repo (not a fork); the PR is draft with no auto-merge. The two `hits` are the whole diff, so there is no lane remainder. Line numbers below are the HEAD file's.

Check-runs on the head, read 2026-10-21T00:42Z (identical to the first reading on 2026-10-20): all 40 completed, none in progress, none failed. The required five: Lint & Repo Gates success · TypeScript Type Check success · Test Core success · Governed Surface Queue Guard success · Build Core skipped (path-filtered by the `filter` job: no package touched). The rest: Check Changeset success (its second, label-fast-path instance skipped) · Check PR Size success · Check Documentation Links success · the four claim/card guards success · Lint · ESLint, docs & code guards, repo & tooling gates, CI release & engine gates, PM dispatch-gates and the three scoped jobs success · Type Check · workspace, source gates, consumer gates, debt ledger success · Dogfood Regression Gate (aggregator) success with its three shards and Dogfood Verify CLI skipped · Auto Label success · Console Pin Gate, Temporal Conformance, Build Docs and the opt-in harnesses skipped.

### ① Derived judgments

The diff changes rules text, not a schema: its accept set is what a dev and the landing seat are now told to do and not do. Each changed rule, judged against its readers and the cited code:

1. **Trigger — os-dev.md L277 「全量 dogfood 只在终 head 跑一次,仅当标题带 `!` 或 `Clause-②:` 带 `(narrowing)` 臂(yes/no 皆算)」: RIGHT.** The arm, not the value, marks breaking, in every reader of that line: clause2-line.mjs L89-101 reads `yes (narrowing)` and `no (narrowing)` as declared narrowings and refuses only `no (widening)`; record-recognisers.mjs L187-188 and L238 put the narrowing face on the arm "whatever the value", and its self-test L1628 pins `yes (narrowing)`; check-adr-0087-registration.mjs L683-684 adds the `clause-②-narrowing` breaking signal on the arm alone, both spellings pinned at L2463-2464; check-changeset-no-major.mjs (the Check Changeset job's reader, pr-automation.yml L1127) L1662-1675 reports the arm beside either value and L1689 names `no (narrowing)` as carrying the axis; AGENTS.md L1088 says `(narrowing)` is BREAKING. Both spellings are EMITTED on the tree: `yes (narrowing)` in .changeset/24583-7b3 and 24583-7a3 (the latter with trailing reasoning, which readArmToken keeps), `no (narrowing)` in 24765 and 24813. The card's `yes (narrowing)`-only spelling would have missed two of those four; the arm-based rule is the reading that honours the card's intent (breaking ⇒ battery), and the dev declared the correction in the PR body (H1) and in the report, the public correction review-checklist.md L68 asks for. The gap the rule closes is real at the head: ci.yml L2037 runs the dogfood shards only when the event is neither `pull_request` nor `merge_group`, so neither PR CI nor the queue ever runs the battery (AGENTS.md L531-533, the two speeds); the card's premise holds. Note, not a finding: no reader in the tree reads `!` off a PR TITLE — check-adr-0087-registration.mjs L677-678 reads the conventional-commit bang off the changeset summary line — so the title half is a seat and dev read, exactly as the card wrote it; 「标题带 `!`」 is to be read at the conventional-commit position (`type(scope)!:`), not as any exclamation mark.

2. **Command — L278 「命令同 CI:按 ① 建闭包,锁下 `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test`;⛔ 无 `OS_TEST_SHARD`、无路径」: RIGHT as the CI equivalent.** packages/qa/dogfood/package.json `test` is `vitest run`; vitest.config.ts L168 `shard: process.env.OS_TEST_SHARD` is the only shard mechanism (L128-136); ci.yml L2146-2157 builds the closure with `pnpm turbo run build --filter=@objectstack/dogfood`, then L2202-2205 runs the same `test` script with `OS_TEST_SHARD=k/3`. The plain command with no shard variable is the union of the three CI shards. One imprecision, named for the lane: 「按 ① 建闭包」 points at 〈本地验证范围〉 ① (L133), whose closure is the TOUCHED package's dependency closure; the closure the battery needs is `@objectstack/dogfood`'s (ci.yml L2162: "the step above builds everything the tests need"). The 「命令同 CI」 anchor and L188 「判断任何事之前先 build」 resolve it, and a dependency left unbuilt fails loud at import (the L178-179 class), never green — so it does not move the verdict; it is the one line to tighten when the file next moves (「按 ① 为 dogfood 建闭包」 or equivalent).

3. **Red disposition — L279 「红 = 本改动的后果(陈旧 fixture)同 PR 修,余照报;⛔ 永不跳过或收窄;计数记 `dogfood_battery`」: RIGHT**, verbatim the card's Done-when.

4. **L88 rewrite 「超前台上限者(`check:pm-dispatch-gates`、全量 dogfood):nohup 重定向后 `tail --pid`」: RIGHT.** The lock classification it no longer states is L87's by name (`check:*` 门禁 … 不走它) and L278's for the battery (锁下 — the backgrounded command is the lock wrapper itself); it composes with L344 (the one anti-polling foreground wait is `tail --pid`) and L345 (a run longer than the turn is read from its log at report time).

5. **L276 split: RIGHT.** The merge-main rule keeps its line; the dogfood clause moves to L277 with its trigger. Commit b8762c089 (verified in history) introduced that clause together with AGENTS.md L586 "dogfood once, on the final head"; AGENTS.md at the head mentions dogfood only there and at L532 (the full battery). The role file adds a trigger and a command to a sentence that states neither; the once-on-the-final-head direction is unchanged on both sides, so nothing conflicts with the file that wins on conflict.

6. **Report field `dogfood_battery` (JSON template L373): RIGHT, additive.** The report's mechanical readers are check-half-states.mjs H52 (the marker line and `open_questions`, L11796-11816) and the `mcp_calls` roster rule check-settings-deny-roster.mjs documents; neither reads another key. SKILL.md L280 keeps the shape in os-dev.md alone — honoured, no second copy. The `n/a — …` spelling is what the dev's own report on this PR already carries.

7. **review-checklist.md L50 「`!` 或 `(narrowing)`:入队前核 `dogfood_battery` 钉 head、全量、红已修/已报;缺或收窄 ⇒ REWORK」: RIGHT.** Named reader (lanes/skills.md L29) = the dispatch seat at the pre-arm read; it sits in the block that already pins every reading to the head (L42-49) and reads the same trigger as L277. landing-operations.md L8-13 remain the 条款② gate and L61 the Tier S landing — no second home needed, no line owed there.

8. **The five deleted lines, each checked for survival (lanes/skills.md L20 「被砍内容若在别处无家,砍掉就是丢规则」): no rule dropped.**
   - os-dev.md 「陷阱在 shell 用法里,不可机械化;⛔ 别等机械强制。」 → lives in L20 (the file carries 钩子无法机械强制的条款) and L186-187 (条款无论 prompt 提没提都生效,沉默不是许可); AGENTS.md states the same ordering twice (the rule outranks the hook, L236-237 and L339-340). A meta line.
   - os-dev.md 「⛔ 不把这类结果写进报告当作一次失败的测量。」 → L175 「两类跑了却没测到,都读作 NOT MEASURED,不读作绿也不读作红」 covers class ② (the 两类 are the ① and ② that follow it), and L102 fixes the spelling (NOT MEASURED, the family, the reason).
   - os-dev.md 「消融本就为证明新门禁能失败时,这份假绿读作门禁没触发,于是有人去弱化一条好门禁。」 → the consequence narrative of L248-249 (the asymmetry; a false green endorsing an assertion that may never fail), whose operative rule is L250-252 (build each leg, prove it reached dist/). AGENTS.md L11-14: a rule carries no incident narrative.
   - os-dev.md 「例:反向验证方向反转、前提死了、某个产物在此无意义;按模板硬造比留白更糟。」 → each example is a rule elsewhere: L242 (报告你实际观察到的方向;永不硬套模板的预设), L384 (`premise_still_valid: false`), L385 (报告模板是工具,不是真相 … 直说).
   - review-checklist.md 「这是合并前唯一的人工关口,⛔ 不只信报告;合并后那一读见 `landing-operations.md`。」 → the rule is execution-duties.md L177 「对 GitHub 核验,⛔ 不对报告的自述核验」; the pointer is its L3 「落地窗口另读 `landing-operations.md`」; the post-merge read itself stands at landing-operations.md L73 and L75 (`closed_by_pull_requests`; cards that left open unexpectedly). 「唯一的人工关口」 is narrative.

9. **Ratchets: RIGHT.** The head blobs measure 404 lines (os-dev.md, ceiling 404 at check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs L1455) and 77 (review-checklist.md, ceiling 77 at L1165); every payment is a whole-line deletion, no re-wrap; the added prose lines measure 112 / 87 / 119 / 120 / 119 / 118 bytes and the template line sits in a fence. Lint · PM dispatch-gates and Lint & Repo Gates are success on the head.

10. **Landing tier and shape: RIGHT.** Both paths under `.claude/` ⇒ Tier S (check-governed-merges.mjs L1178; landing-operations.md L61); Governed Surface Queue Guard success on the head; no CI, workflow, gate or script change, as the card's ⛔ orders; dispatch-runbook.md and execution-duties.md untouched is right (os-dev.md L186: 无条件条款住这里). `Fixes #24890` on the first line is right: the whole Done-when is delivered. The 维护者速读 section is present with its five parts (L288-289); the body ends in the session-URL footer; the head commit carries the model-free trailer pair.

### ② Semver level

`skip-changeset`: RIGHT. The diff is `.claude/**` only — the fast lane os-dev.md L300 names; nothing in any package's `files[]` moves, and no `.changeset/*.md` is edited. The label was applied in the pr_create stroke and is on the PR; Check Changeset is success on the head. `Clause-②: no` on the PR body (L3) is the claim's line copied verbatim (os-dev.md L280): no accept set widens and no published surface narrows. No `(narrowing)` arm and no `!` in the title ⇒ this PR owes no battery; the report's `dogfood_battery: "n/a — …"` is the field's own first correct use.

### ③ Boundary flags

`open_questions`: empty — nothing to answer. Each `deviations` entry: (1) branch off a8b44d407 after the brief's lead at fcb40ad67 — merge-base verified a8b44d407, same 21 derived families: answered. (2) doc-formula-expressions exit 3 PREREQUISITE NOT MET, then 0 after the prerequisite build — honest, and Lint · docs & code guards is success on the head: answered. (3) battery wall time NOT MEASURED — not owed on this PR; accepted (the 速读's 预计超过十分钟 is stated as an estimate, not a reading). (4) `vitest list` ignores the shard variable — vitest.config.ts L168 confirms the shard applies to `run` only: answered. (5) the model-named trailer declined — the head commit carries `Claude-Session:` and a model-free Co-authored-by line, verified from the object: answered. (6) label read-back via a REST read — `skip-changeset` present in the PR's labels: answered.

`out_of_scope_findings` and the Acceptance notes: (a) contract-review.md L12 spells only `no (narrowing)` as the tier-lifting spelling while the reader lifts on the arm with either value — CONFIRMED, and wider than the dev noted: record-recognisers.mjs's own prose (L131, the REVIEW_FACES words at L156, the --template help at L1053-1054) names the one spelling too, while its code (L238) and self-test (L1628) read `yes (narrowing)`. Not a class a/b/c finding; ESCALATED to the domain:skills lane as a one-line follow-up on contract-review.md L12 with the record-recognisers.mjs prose rider (same lane: `scripts/pm/**` and `.claude/skills/**`), carried on the lane's next governed PR together with this review's own ①.2 note on the closure wording. (b) the NOT MEASURED-on-destroyed-evidence rule stated on the dev side (os-dev.md L176) and the seat side (review-checklist.md L36) — two readers, by design; no action. (c) ci.yml L627 and L2027 "~7½-minute" comments predate the three-shard job — observation; no action; carrier none accepted.

Implemented-by: `claude/issue-24890-breaking-dogfood-battery`
Reviewed-by: `session_01M82feuetLzrCiBz41BJb7L`

**VERDICT: PASS**

   - The seat read the whole diff: the trigger, the command, the red disposition, the `dogfood_battery` report field and the checklist line that reads it.
   - Each of the five deleted lines was traced, by the seat and by the review, to where its content still lives (review ①.8).

The tree's readers (`clause2-line.mjs`, `record-recognisers.mjs`, `check-adr-0087-registration.mjs`, `check-changeset-no-major.mjs`) all do the same, and both spellings occur in `.changeset/*` on main. This corrects the card's `yes (narrowing)`-only spelling (dev H1).
3. **Gate check-runs**, pinned to this head (2026-10-21T00:42Z, per the review): 40 completed, 0 failures. `Lint & Repo Gates`, `TypeScript Type Check`, `Test Core`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard` and every Lint · and Type Check · lane are success. `check-expected-skips.mjs --pr 24917`, from a checkout pinned to `origin/main` `62bc12930`: `roster: identical to … main's tip`, then `OK — 14 skipped check-run(s), every one in main's roster (exit 0)`. The contract review of record is comment 6305134343 (`Served-tier: CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`, this head, `Local-runs: none`, **PASS**), rendered by an isolated subagent at that tier and adopted by this seat.
4. **Accepted deviations.**
   - The branch is off `a8b44d407`, not the dispatch's `fcb40ad67`; the same 21 families were derived.
   - The battery's wall time is NOT MEASURED. This PR owes no run, and its own `dogfood_battery` is `n/a`.
   - The model-free commit trailers follow AGENTS.md.
5. **Out-of-scope findings and review notes.** None is a class a, b or c finding; each goes to the seat post's carried pointers.
   - `contract-review.md` L12, and the prose of `record-recognisers.mjs`, spell only `no (narrowing)` as the tier-lifting declaration, while the code lifts on the arm with either value (review ③ (a)). The tree's reader is right, and a wrong seat tier is refused loudly by it, so nothing goes through silently. The prose is tightened at the next edit of either file, paid by compression.
   - os-dev.md L278's 「按 ① 建闭包」 should name the dogfood package's closure (review ①.2). It is tightened at the file's next edit.
   - The NOT MEASURED-on-destroyed-evidence rule appears on both sides, dev and seat, by design. No action.
   - The ci.yml "~7½-minute" comments predate the three-shard job. Observation only.
6. **Landing.** Tier S with an at-tier PASS on this head and every check green: the seat flips it ready, arms auto-merge once `mergeable_state` settles, follows it to MERGED, then closes out #24890.
